I don't like the Platinum 3776
I actually don't know if that's controversial since I don't talk to many fountain pen folks.
But!
Even before the price increase, I would not have recommended it. (Especially now though!)

Heck yes, inks are fun!
And fountain pens are nice in that you really don't need the most expensive stuff to have a good time.
Very much a subjective hobby.
